variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.body: The company {company} has laid off many workers. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: A large loss of jobs at a company

variants.headline: Workers face a company layoff
variants.body: The company {company} has carried out a large layoff. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.
